_doc: Scoring rubric for Clarity friction + engagement signals. Read at runtime by scripts/track_clarity_cron.py. Tune weights here without touching code — restart of the cron picks them up next run. Per the v5 Clarity integration plan, weights are starting values; spot-check after a week of data and adjust if rankings don't match intuition.
_min_sessions_floor_note: URLs with fewer than this many sessions in the snapshot window are flagged low_confidence and excluded from leaderboards / ChangeSet triggers. Lowered from 50 → 10 (2026-05-07) after first real snapshot showed top URL at 47 sessions/day — the 50 floor was excluding everything. anomaly_detection.min_sessions_both_snapshots stays at 50 (week-over-week diff needs higher confidence than single-snapshot ranking).
_min_sessions_floor_history: 100 → 50 (Devon v3, expected Ashton-Hall ~99 sessions/day) → 10 (2026-05-07, post-real-data calibration).

_friction_weights_rationale.rage_clicks: Highest-confidence frustration signal — repeated clicks indicate genuine struggle
_friction_weights_rationale.dead_clicks: UX affordance failure — user thought something was interactive when it wasn't
_friction_weights_rationale.excessive_scroll: Content discovery friction (ambiguous: could be exploration, but typically struggle)
_friction_weights_rationale.quickback_clicks: Wrong-link friction — less direct than rage but clear navigation issue
_friction_weights_rationale.error_clicks: Real friction but lower severity (errors were handled)
_friction_weights_rationale.script_errors: Technical health signal — doesn't always block users but indicates fragility

_engagement_weights_rationale.engagement_time_sec: Active engagement (excludes idle) — best single signal of content resonance. Tentative weight pending calibration.
_engagement_weights_rationale.scroll_depth_pct: Content consumption — held attention through. Tentative weight pending calibration.

downstream_triggers._doc: Score thresholds that downstream consumers (Phase 3 ChangeSet generation, auto-optimize hypothesis generation, anomaly detection) use. Centralized here so tuning is one-line.

anomaly_detection._doc: Week-over-week detector (v1, threshold-based). Compares today's snapshot to N-7 days ago (±fallback_window_days if exact day missing). Flags URLs that meaningfully worsened on health_score OR friction_score. Activates from day 8 of snapshot history; before that, returns []. Tune thresholds here; cron picks them up next run.
anomaly_detection._future_v2_sigma: Once 14+ days of history accumulate, swap to sigma-based detection (friction_score_increase_sigma=1.5 over baseline_window_days=14). Captures URLs that worsened relative to their own variance, not just a flat threshold.
